state.system: A 166700-neuron fly model with a synthetic MuJoCo roller body and a fixed predeclared neural reader. Stage3 confirmation is still running. No Stage4 organism has been executed.
state.observations: A binary lateral field produced about +0.093 degrees for left odor, -0.059 for right, and +0.024 for sham over 400ms. A proposed fixed Gaussian source gives pose-dependent antennal concentrations; offline replay on saved binary-field trajectories changes each sample by about 0.02-0.04 and makes two source locations differ by about 0.04-0.06 at 400ms. These are geometry calculations, not consumed neural inputs in a Gaussian run. The body advances tonically around 0.2mm/s. Full 2-4s organism comparisons are estimated to cost many hours.
state.task: Triage narrowly defined experimental controls. Do not infer scientific acceptance or biological equivalence.

feedback_control.instructions: Which single comparison can distinguish pose-contingent sensory feedback from an open-loop sensory sequence in a deterministic simulated organism? Classify the control design, not whether the organism passes.

criteria.matched_perturbed_online_vs_replay: Fork the same full state, impose the same predefined physical pose perturbation, then compare live pose-dependent odor samples against a fixed donor sensory replay.
criteria.unperturbed_self_replay: Replay the exact input sequence from the same unperturbed deterministic trajectory and compare with itself.
criteria.left_right_sham_only: Compare left and right odor with sham, without changing pose or replaying samples.
criteria.uncertain: The supplied information does not identify a useful control.

next_discriminator.instructions: After Stage3 is resolved, which first empirical step is most informative under a limited budget before a long Stage4 campaign? Classify priority only; scientific thresholds remain local.

criteria.short_consumed_gradient_probe: Run one bounded Gaussian organism probe to measure actual delivered antennal/ORN, PN, DN and command changes, checking whether a continuous gradient propagates.
criteria.immediate_long_feedback_cohort: Run all multi-second online, replay, sham and uniform arms before any short probe.
criteria.geometry_only: Stop after offline geometry because it proves functional neural feedback.
criteria.uncertain: The supplied information does not justify a ranking.
